# Vibelly

> Vibelly (https://vibelly.fun) is a free, browser-based random video chat for adults 18+. Users are matched with strangers worldwide for video or text chat, with no sign-up required. Voice-only calls and gender/country filters are part of Vibelly Premium.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vibelly.fun/): start a random video, voice, or text chat
- [Omegle alternative](https://vibelly.fun/omegle-alternative): why Omegle shut down and how Vibelly differs
- [OmeTV alternative](https://vibelly.fun/ometv-alternative): random video chat without a Facebook or VK login
- [Chatroulette alternative](https://vibelly.fun/chatroulette-alternative)
- [Random video chat](https://vibelly.fun/random-video-chat)
- [Talk to strangers](https://vibelly.fun/talk-to-strangers)
- [Safety & Community Rules](https://vibelly.fun/safety): 18+ policy, reporting, and bans
- [About](https://vibelly.fun/about): who runs Vibelly (Naimish Omar) and how it is funded
- [Pricing](https://vibelly.fun/pricing): Vibelly Premium
- [Contact](https://vibelly.fun/contact): vibellyofficial@gmail.com

## Guides

- [What Happened to Omegle? Why It Shut Down and What Came Next](https://vibelly.fun/blog/what-happened-to-omegle): Omegle went offline in November 2023 after 14 years. Here is why it closed, what made it so popular, and what to look for in a random video chat site today.
- [How to Stay Safe on Random Video Chat: A Practical Checklist](https://vibelly.fun/blog/random-video-chat-safety-checklist): A practical safety checklist for random video chat: what never to share, how scams usually start, how to handle uncomfortable moments, and how to report people.
- [How to Choose an Omegle Alternative: 7 Things That Actually Matter](https://vibelly.fun/blog/how-to-choose-an-omegle-alternative): Not all Omegle alternatives are equal. Seven practical criteria for comparing random video chat sites, from age policy and reporting to privacy, cost, and login requirements.
- [How to Start a Conversation With a Stranger on Video Chat](https://vibelly.fun/blog/how-to-start-a-conversation-with-a-stranger): Opening lines, questions that work, and how to keep a conversation with a stranger going on random video chat without it feeling awkward.
- [How to Practice a Language With Native Speakers on Random Video Chat](https://vibelly.fun/blog/practice-a-language-on-video-chat): Random video chat is an underrated way to practice speaking a new language. How to find native speakers, what to say, and how to turn short chats into real progress.
